info.title: Floris Client API
info.description: The complete, platform-neutral client boundary shared by Web, Android, HarmonyOS and iOS. Every server-owned value displayed by a Floris client is delivered through an operation below or through the versioned SSE/component contracts. Authentication, tenant scoping, orchestration, provider calls and persistence remain server responsibilities.

x-floris-platform-adapters.identity_provider: Use the official CloudBase SDK only for provider login and refresh; exchange the provider access token through /auth/mobile/session or /auth/cloudbase/session before calling Floris business APIs.
x-floris-platform-adapters.system_location: Obtain a consented, short-lived OS location and pass it to /chat or /routes; the server remains authoritative for place resolution and route planning.
x-floris-platform-adapters.map_renderer: Render server-issued place and route geometry with the platform map SDK; do not ask the map SDK to replace /places or /routes.
x-floris-platform-adapters.local_files: File picking, PDF rendering/text extraction, ZIP construction and cache storage are replaceable client adapters; persistence and model operations still use Floris APIs.
x-floris-platform-adapters.presigned_upload: PUT is allowed only to the short-lived URL returned by /files, /profile or /skill-uploads; clients never construct storage keys or upload origins.
